note: Adjudicated held-out investigation set. Cases IV01-IV16 are carried over from investigation-eval-v1 BYTE-FOR-BYTE; the original files remain in place and the metrics recorded against them stay attributable to that version. What changed in v2 is the LABELS for IV03/IV04/IV08 (see investigation_labels_v2.json) plus three added cases that make the restart decision boundary testable. Operational evidence is collected from the shared Northstar fixtures, so cases on the same service receive the same operational signals — that property is what the adjudication is about.
